tutorial.title: Tutorial
tutorial.subtitle: A training battle against the computer, with a guide that explains each part of the screen while you play. The guided part is the beginning; the rest of the battle is for practice.
tutorial.teamText: In training the team is already built, the opponent is always the same and the computer goes easy on you. Afterwards you pick your own five.

goal.title: Goal
goal.text: Each side brings 5 characters. Whoever takes down the whole other team wins.

turns.title: Turns
turns.text: Each turn every character acts once, from fastest to slowest.

energy.title: Energy
energy.text: The team shares one energy pool: 3 on the first turn and 1 more each turn, up to 10. Leftover energy does not carry over.

skills.title: Skills
skills.text: Every character has a free attack and stronger skills that cost energy.

passives.title: Passives
passives.text: Every character has a passive skill. Nobody has to use it: it makes their strikes stronger or acts on its own at the start of their turn.

effects.title: Effects
effects.text: Some skills leave effects for a few turns: burn, poison, stun, shield and changes to attack, defense and speed.

berserk.title: Berserk
berserk.text: From turn 9 on, the damage of every skill grows 50% each turn, for both teams.

tutorial.opening: The battle is about to start. The guide will talk to you as soon as it is your turn.
tutorial.idle: Keep playing. A new tip shows up when something you have not seen yet happens.
tutorial.done: You have seen the basics. Now build your own team against the computer or invite someone to multiplayer.

welcome.title: Welcome to training
welcome.text: Both teams are labelled in the arena: yours and the enemy. Whoever takes down all five characters on the other side wins.

queue.title: Action order
queue.text: The queue at the top shows who acts this turn, from fastest to slowest. Each character acts once per turn, and the bigger portrait is the one acting now.

energy.title: Energy
energy.text: The whole team shares one energy pool. It is 3 on the first turn and 1 more each turn, up to 10. Leftover energy does not carry over to the next turn.

skills.title: Skills
skills.text: It is {{unit}}'s turn. Each card shows the energy cost, what the skill does and its base damage or healing. Every character has a free attack. Click a card to choose it.

target.title: Target
target.text: Possible targets are marked in the arena. Click an enemy to attack. If the skill hits everyone at once, confirm with the Use button.

damage.title: First strike
damage.text: The number that floats up is the damage, and the bar under each character is their health. Now the others act, each on their turn; the computer plays for the enemy.

passive.title: Passive
passive.text: The last card, tagged Passive, is not for clicking: it is a skill that works on its own. Each character has one; read it to know when it helps.

area.title: Area skill
area.text: This skill needs no target: it hits everyone that is marked. Confirm with the Use button.

allySkill.title: Support skill
allySkill.text: This skill is for your team: the marked characters are your allies. Click the one who should receive it.

noEnergy.title: Out of energy
noEnergy.text: Dimmed cards cost more energy than the team has right now. The free attack is always available, and next turn the energy is full again.

status.title: Effects
status.text: The badges under a character are effects that last a few turns, such as burn, stun and shield. The number is how many turns are left; hover a badge to see what it does.

newTurn.title: New turn
newTurn.text: Everyone has acted, so another turn started. Energy is full again, with 1 more, and the queue was rebuilt by speed.

defeated.title: Character defeated
defeated.text: A character that reaches 0 health falls and leaves the queue. The battle ends when one team has nobody standing.

berserk.title: Berserk
berserk.text: From turn 9 on, the damage of every skill increases 50% each turn, for both teams. It is what keeps a battle from lasting forever.
